result.finding: No environment variables are configured via Dockerfile, docker-compose, Kubernetes, or .env files. All configuration is hardcoded in application.yaml, including database credentials. The Oracle Docker container uses one environment variable (ORACLE_PWD) passed via the docker run command in README.md.
evidence: No Dockerfile found — no ENV instructions
No docker-compose.yml found — no environment section
No Kubernetes manifests found — no env/envFrom configuration
application.yaml contains hardcoded values: datasource.url=jdbc:oracle:thin:@localhost:1521/XEPDB1, datasource.username=system, datasource.password=oracle, server.port=8080
README.md Oracle docker run command uses: -e ORACLE_PWD=oracle
values: ORACLE_PWD=oracle (Oracle DB container only, from docker run command)
